perplexity.description:
Bees In The Bonnet is the 2025 release by Norwegian power trio Hedvig Mollestad Trio, continuing their signature blend of jazz, heavy rock, and progressive psychedelia on Rune Grammofon. The album showcases the group’s dynamic interplay, with Hedvig Mollestad’s incisive guitar work, Ellen Brekken’s robust bass lines, and Ivar Loe Bjørnstad’s propulsive drumming driving a set of adventurous, rhythmically complex compositions. The music balances moments of melodic accessibility with exploratory improvisation, reflecting the trio’s ongoing commitment to blurring genre boundaries and pushing the limits of instrumental rock and jazz fusion.

As the latest chapter in a prolific discography that includes acclaimed albums like Smells Funny and Ding Dong. You’re Dead, Bees In The Bonnet further cements Hedvig Mollestad Trio’s reputation as one of Norway’s most innovative and energetic ensembles. The album has been praised for its tight performances, inventive arrangements, and the trio’s ability to merge the raw power of rock with the harmonic sophistication of jazz. Critics have highlighted its vibrant energy and creative risk-taking, noting its place among the most compelling contemporary releases in the jazz-rock and avant-garde scenes.
